note: The silent order round the old temple of Envar. Its people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Envar): Elder Ithrael, on the road before the temple's east door, gives the first two; Watcher Vaeris, a few steps south of him, the three hunts; Artificer Maelis, on the road's north side, is the outfitter; Coachman Therun keeps the stable a few steps north-east (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes). The ash grubs (the dead hills to the east), the cinder adders (the low hills to the north-east) and the Hollow Pilgrim, one of the temple's dead that wandered out (the hill beyond the grubs), are placed for these quests. The Jal'Raeth speak little, and of stillness. Highbourne stands on Tunaria's west coast: the flight's words name no land across the sea. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Watcher Vaeris gives L7-L15, Elder Ithrael the L20 path; their objectives are on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Therun's coach): badger pelts and drift rat fur, Maelis's shaft and rime spider silk, five frostpaw cubs (no more), the Rimeheart's shard for the order to study, then a vigil with Spiritmaster Oswin and Scout Feyla's raiders.

L1.name: A Novice's Prayer Beads
offer: Be still. Good. You have come out of the long quiet and into the noise of the world. It will pass. Everything loud does.
Each novice of the order counts its breaths on a string of temple beads. Artificer Maelis strings them, a few steps north of here.
Will you fetch your beads and show them to me?
L1.declined: Then wait. Waiting, too, is practice.
L1.started: Maelis is a few steps to the north, on the road's far side.

piece.name: novice's prayer beads
piece.description: A string of grey stone beads from the temple of Envar. A novice of the Jal'Raeth counts its breaths on them.

fetch.journal: Ask Artificer Maelis, a few steps north of Elder Ithrael, for a novice's prayer beads.
fetch.says: A novice. Hold out your hand. One bead for each breath, and when the string ends, begin again. The order asks no coin of its own.

show.journal: Show the novice's prayer beads to Elder Ithrael.
show.says: Count on them when the world grows loud. It will. Now you are one of the order, and the order is quiet.

L2.name: Anchored at Envar
offer: A mind adrift is lost. Have Spiritmaster Oravai anchor your spirit at Envar, so that you return to this road if the world unmakes you.
Then give your name to Coachman Therun for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands.
Will you see them both and return to me?
L2.declined: Then go nowhere you cannot walk back from.
L2.started: Oravai waits to the south-west. Therun is a few steps behind you, by the road.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Oravai, south-west of the elder, bind your spirit to Envar.
bind.says: It is done. Whatever unmakes you, you will gather again on this road. Now give Coachman Therun your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Therun, by the road just east of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: A novice. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now. I will not speak on the road. You will be glad of it.

says: Good. Now you have a place to return to, and may go out from it.
Therun's coach goes where its ledgers know you, but the scholars' door is earned. Watcher Vaeris, a few steps south, has work for you.

L3.name: Grubs in the Dead Hills
offer: The novice. Good. Ash grubs breed in the dead hills east of the road, and they have begun to gnaw at the temple's stones.
Thin them, and bring me three of their teeth. Then I will show you a thing the order teaches.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: Stone is patient. It will be eaten slowly.
L3.started: Three teeth. East, where the road runs out into the hills.

drop.name: ash grub tooth
drop.description: The tooth of an ash grub from the dead hills east of Envar.

hunt.journal: Take three ash grub teeth from the ash grubs in the dead hills east of the road.

give.journal: Bring three ash grub teeth to Watcher Vaeris.
give.says: Three teeth. You did not hurry, and you did not falter. Now watch, and learn this.

L4.name: A Novice's Arms
offer: A still mind is not enough in the lands beyond. I will make you proper gear, but you will bring what it needs.
Artificer Maelis has cord and a shaft set aside. Then take a fang from the cinder adders on the low hills to the north-east.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then go unarmed, and be very still indeed.
L4.started: Cord and a shaft from Maelis, a fang from the adders. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Artificer Maelis for the silk cord and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Vaeris. Here: cord, and a shaft cut straight. Use them once, and well.

drop.name: cinder adder fang
drop.description: The fang of a cinder adder from the low hills north-east of Envar.

hunt.journal: Take a cinder adder fang from the cinder adders on the low hills north-east of the road.

give.journal: Bring the silk cord, the wooden shaft and the cinder adder fang to Watcher Vaeris.
give.says: All three. Be patient a moment... there. It is yours. Do not grow fond of it. It is a tool.

L5.name: The Hollow Pilgrim
offer: One task more. The temple's dead keep to the temple, but one has wandered out: a hollow thing in a pilgrim's rags, on the hill east of the grubs.
It has no stillness left, only hunger, and it will come at you on sight. Give it rest, and bring me a bone of it for the crypt.
Will you lay the Hollow Pilgrim to rest?
L5.accept: I will lay it to rest.
L5.declined: It does not sleep. It will be there.
L5.started: East, through the grubs' hills, to the rise beyond. It will see you first.

drop.name: Hollow Pilgrim's bone
drop.description: A brittle bone of the Hollow Pilgrim, to be laid back in the crypt of Envar.

hunt.journal: Take the Hollow Pilgrim's bone from the Hollow Pilgrim on the hill east of the ash grubs.

give.journal: Bring the Hollow Pilgrim's bone to Watcher Vaeris.
says: It rests, then. I will see the bone laid where it belongs. You are a novice no longer.
Learn this, and go to Gatekeeper Tavrin at the temple's east door when you are ready for Highbourne.

flight.name: The Scholars' City
offer: The scholars of Highbourne, on Tunaria's western shore, took in the first of us, eager for what we know. They will teach you in turn.
You have earned the door. I will set you down among your own guild in Highbourne, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Highbourne?
flight.started: Drift well, and keep your mind still!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Tavrin when you are ready to go to Highbourne.

L7.name: Two Tasks in the Cold
offer: The order sends its novices into the cold once, to learn that stillness is not sleep. The Homelands keep an outpost on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie.
Ride Therun's coach there. Take two badger pelts and a clump of drift rat fur from the snow east of the outpost. Do not hurry.
Will you do the two tasks?
L7.declined: The cold will wait. It always does.
L7.started: Breathe slowly. The cold is only loud.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

drop.name: drift rat fur
drop.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take a clump of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the two badger pelts and the drift rat fur to Watcher Vaeris.
give.says: Two pelts and a clump of fur, and your breath still even. The cold taught you. Now watch, and learn this.

L10.name: A Tool for the Road
offer: The tool I gave you served a novice. You need a better one. Do not grow fond of this one either.
Artificer Maelis has a shaft for me. Then take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost, to bind it.
Will you bring me the shaft and the silk?
L10.declined: Then the old tool must do. Tools usually do.
L10.started: A shaft from Maelis, silk from the spiders. Be patient with both.

materials.journal: Ask Artificer Maelis for the wooden shaft Vaeris set aside.
materials.says: For Vaeris, again. Here. Cut straight, and dried a full season. A tool is only as still as the hand that holds it.

drop.name: rime spider silk
drop.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the wooden shaft and the rime spider silk to Watcher Vaeris.
give.says: Shaft and silk. Be patient a moment... there. It is yours. Use it, and do not name it.

L13.name: Hunger in the Snow
offer: There is too much hunger on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost. The frostpaw cubs grow, and the snow's game thins, and the outpost's hunters go hungry.
We take nothing for sport. Thin them by five, no more, and the snow will be still again.
Will you thin the frostpaw cubs?
L13.started: Five. Count them, and stop at five.

hunt.journal: Kill five frostpaw cubs on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost.

back.says: Five, and you stopped. That is harder than it sounds. Learn this.

L15.name: The Unmelting Shard
offer: Something in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost does not rest. The hunters call it the Rimeheart. It is old, and it is never still.
The order would study such a thing. Break it, and bring me a shard. Ice that does not melt has something to teach.
Will you bring me a shard of the Rimeheart?
L15.declined: It will still be there. That is its trouble.
L15.started: Go with others. Stillness is not standing alone.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Watcher Vaeris.
give.says: It is cold even through the cloth. The order will sit with it a long while. You have done well. Learn this.

L20.name: The Vigil at the Eyrie
offer: Vaeris says you are a novice no longer. Each of the order keeps one vigil far from Envar, among other peoples, so that it learns its stillness is its own.
Sit with Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost, then go where Scout Feyla needs you. When it is done, return, and choose your path.
Will you keep the vigil?
L20.declined: A vigil kept too soon is only waiting.

road.journal: Sit the vigil with Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: A Jal'Raeth, come to sit with me? Sit, then. ... Good. The scout on the river has need of a steady hand. Go to Feyla.

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Oswin sent you? Then you will not panic. The Goldfeather raiders carry war-talons. Bring me three.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
handin.says: Three. And not a word wasted. Go home, quiet one. Your elder will want to hear it, though you will not say much.

final.journal: Return to Elder Ithrael at Envar.
final.says: The vigil is kept. You went out into the noise and came back still. The order has one more thing to give you.
